MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
========================================================================
MappingPocPage(services)
  |
  v
MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
  | diagrams                | canvasHistory          | workspaceStorage?
  v                         v                        v
DiagramService [G]     CanvasHistoryService [E]   WorkspaceStorage
  |                         |                        |
  +------------+------------+                        |
               v                                     |
CanvasWorkspace                                      |
  +-- drafts[documentId]                              |
  |     +-- metadata: name, savedName, revisionId     |
  |     |   savedScene, savedEdges, hidden, busy      |
  |     +-- viewport / focusBox / reloadKey           |
  |     +-- CanvasSession                            |
  +-- controllers: Map<documentId, controller>        |
  +-- dirtyScenes: ids                               |
               |                                     |
               v                                     |
CanvasSession: one controller + readable stores      |
  | document | presentation | selection | controls   |
  | geometry | status(isDirty, sceneDirty, undo/redo) |
  | immutable references published synchronously     |
  | onCommit when canvasRevisionId changes           |
  v                                                  |
MappingDocumentController [D]                        |
  | owns {document, canvas} and runtime snapshot     |
  | contextId / canvasRevisionId / version           |
  | cell / endpointBounds / canUndo / canRedo        |
  |                                                  |
  +-- MappingGridDocument -----------------------+   |
  |     |                                        |   |
  |     +-- scene: LineGridScene [A]              |   |
  |     |     +-- root: GridBox ownership tree    |   |
  |     |     +-- contents[contentId]: Diagram [B]|   |
  |     +-- edges: DiagramConnection[]           |   |
  |     +-- jumps?: CanvasJump[]                 |   |
  |     +-- sections[contentId]                   |   |
  |                                              |   |
  +-- MappingCanvasState ------------------------+   |
        |                                            |
        +-- selection: SelectionState                |
        |     items[] = whole diagram OR region      |
        |     displayNodeId + captured region context|
        |     membership + insertion order           |
        +-- diagramViews[displayNodeId]              |
        |     contentRevisionId + collapsed node IDs |
        +-- display: DisplayState [C]                |
        |     rootIds + nodes[id]: FloatingPane      |
        |     ownership via childIds                 |
        +-- controls: MappingControls               |
              activeBoxId / selectionFocusId         |
              activeThreadId / surfaces[id]          |
              action, prompt, ask, status state      |
                                                     |
document + canvas + version + measured geometry       |
  |                                                  |
  v                                                  |
canvasDisplayNodes(): derived read-only registry      |
  +-- grid:<boxId>     diagram/group; cell bounds     |
  +-- floating:<id>    pane; pixel geometry           |
  +-- floating:edge:*  arrow from document.edges      |
  |   nodes() returns a clone; geometry has one owner |
  v                                                  |
MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)                    |
  ^ inside DraggableDiagramCanvas                    |
  | mounted document views; active/hidden gates      |
  +-- undo / transfer / jump / edit callbacks         |
                                                     |
MappingWorkspacePage orchestration                   |
  +-- explorer + search + ChangeSessionPreview        |
  +-- DiagramEditCoordinator -> DiagramEditComposer   |
  +-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand [D]  |
  +-- open / create / save / restore / import / export|
  +-- copy/move + workspace undo/redo [E]              |
                                                     |
SourcePaneViewState: live scroll + camera             |
  | captureDisplay / captureCamera; flush             |
  v                                                  |
WorkspacePersistence <--- session commits + view events
  | metadata + baseline + history deltas + canvas     |
  | viewport + workspace index(activeId, transfers)   |
  v                                                  v
RecordStorage.batch -> worker transport -> workspace records
  |
  +-- explicit transfer: storage.save -> ACK -> installWorkspace
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sources: MappingPage.tsx; canvasWorkspace.ts; canvasSession.ts;
mappingWorkspace.ts; mappingGrid.ts; canvasDisplayNode.ts
